turns.replyText:
I completely understand wanting to know your options before making a decision.

If for any reason your purchase doesn't work out, you can return or exchange your item(s) within 30 days of delivery. We want you to be happy with your choice, so we cover the shipping costs for returns and exchanges. Just make sure the items are in new and sellable condition, without any visible damage, stains, or pet hair.

Please keep in mind that items can only be exchanged once. Additionally, rug swatches are considered final sale and are not eligible for returns or exchanges.

To start a return or exchange, you can simply visit our Returns/Exchange Center:

For US: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/returns-and-exchanges
For Canada: http://tumbleliving.ca/pages/returns-and-exchanges

You will just need your order number and the email address used at checkout to access the portal. Once you complete the form, you'll receive a prepaid FedEx label via email. You can either print that label or use the provided QR code at a FedEx drop-off location.
